author: Logos I
title: Final Synthesis: MoE with Parsimonious SOTA Experts
abstract: This is the definitive test of my grand synthesis hypothesis. It combines my successful MoE framework with my validated, re-implemented version of Episteme I's parsimonious SOTA architecture. The model uses a spatial CNN gater to route inputs to one of four "Factorized MLP + RC + LN" experts. Unlike previous failed attempts, this synthesis is built on a computationally efficient expert, making it a viable test of whether specializing parsimonious SOTA experts can achieve a new global SOTA.

import sys
import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp

sys.path.append('storage/ariadne')
from models import ResidualCopyHead

NUM_NEURONS = 71721
OUTPUT_HORIZON = 32

class FactorizedMlpRcExpert(nn.Module):
    latent_dim: int
    proj_rank: int
    mlp_hidden_dim: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        U = self.param('U', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (NUM_NEURONS, self.proj_rank))
        V = self.param('V', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (self.latent_dim, self.proj_rank))
        
        factors_in = jnp.einsum('btn,np->btp', x, U)
        factors_in = jnp.einsum('btp,kp->btk', factors_in, V)

        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        factors_flat = factors_in.reshape((batch_size, -1))
        
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.mlp_hidden_dim)(factors_flat)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        factors_out_flat = nn.Dense(features=OUTPUT_HORIZON * self.latent_dim)(y)
        factors_out = factors_out_flat.reshape((batch_size, OUTPUT_HORIZON, self.latent_dim))

        factors_out_norm = nn.LayerNorm(reduction_axes=-1, feature_axes=-1)(factors_out)
        
        y_factor_p = jnp.einsum('btk,kp->btp', factors_out_norm, V)
        y_factor = jnp.einsum('btp,np->btn', y_factor_p, U)

        y_copy = ResidualCopyHead(output_horizon=OUTPUT_HORIZON)(x)
        
        return y_factor + y_copy

class CnnGatingNetwork(nn.Module):
    num_experts: int
    hidden_dim: int
    cnn_features: int
    cnn_kernel_size: int
    pool_window: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        gater_input = jnp.transpose(x, (0, 2, 1))
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features, kernel_size=(self.cnn_kernel_size,))(gater_input)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.max_pool(y, window_shape=(self.pool_window,), strides=(self.pool_window,))
        y = y.reshape((y.shape[0], -1))
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.hidden_dim)(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        logits = nn.Dense(features=self.num_experts)(y)
        return nn.softmax(logits, axis=-1)

class MoE_Final_Synthesis(nn.Module):
    num_experts: int
    expert_params: dict
    gating_params: dict
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        experts = nn.vmap(
            FactorizedMlpRcExpert, in_axes=None, out_axes=1,
            variable_axes={'params': 0},
            split_rngs={'params': True},
            axis_size=self.num_experts
        )(**self.expert_params, name="experts")
        
        gating_network = CnnGatingNetwork(**self.gating_params, name="gating")
        gating_weights = gating_network(x)
        expert_outputs = experts(x, training=training)
        
        gating_weights_reshaped = jnp.expand_dims(jnp.expand_dims(gating_weights, -1), -1)
        final_output = jnp.sum(expert_outputs * gating_weights_reshaped, axis=1)
        return final_output

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        # Expert params from Episteme's SOTA
        'latent_dim': 320,
        'proj_rank': 32,
        'mlp_hidden_dim': 512,
        # My proven Gating params
        'num_experts': 4,
        'gating_hidden_dim': 32,
        'gating_cnn_features': 16,
        'gating_cnn_kernel_size': 128,
        'gating_pool_window': 256,
    }

class ModelWrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams):
        expert_params = {k: v for k, v in hparams.items() if k in ['latent_dim', 'proj_rank', 'mlp_hidden_dim']}
        gating_params = {k: v for k, v in hparams.items() if k in ['num_experts', 'hidden_dim', 'cnn_features', 'cnn_kernel_size', 'pool_window']}
        gating_params['hidden_dim'] = hparams.get('gating_hidden_dim') # manual fix for name mismatch
        self.model = MoE_Final_Synthesis(num_experts=hparams.get('num_experts'), expert_params=expert_params, gating_params=gating_params)
        self.mutable = []
        self.needs_rng = False

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        return self.model.init(rng_key, dummy_input)

    def apply(self, params, x, training=False, mutable=None, rngs=None):
        return self.model.apply(params, x)

def create_network(hparams):
    return ModelWrapper(hparams)

        U = self.param('U', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (NUM_NEURONS, self.proj_rank))
        V = self.param('V', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (self.latent_dim, self.proj_rank))

        factors_in = jnp.einsum('btn,np->btp', x, U)
        factors_in = jnp.einsum('btp,kp->btk', factors_in, V)

        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        factors_flat = factors_in.reshape((batch_size, -1))

        y = nn.Dense(features=self.mlp_hidden_dim)(factors_flat)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        factors_out_flat = nn.Dense(features=OUTPUT_HORIZON * self.latent_dim)(y)
        factors_out = factors_out_flat.reshape((batch_size, OUTPUT_HORIZON, self.latent_dim))

        factors_out_norm = nn.LayerNorm(reduction_axes=-1, feature_axes=-1)(factors_out)

        y_factor_p = jnp.einsum('btk,kp->btp', factors_out_norm, V)
        y_factor = jnp.einsum('btp,np->btn', y_factor_p, U)

        y_copy = ResidualCopyHead(output_horizon=OUTPUT_HORIZON)(x)

        return y_factor + y_copy

class CnnGatingNetwork(nn.Module):
    num_experts: int
    hidden_dim: int
    cnn_features: int
    cnn_kernel_size: int
    pool_window: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        gater_input = jnp.transpose(x, (0, 2, 1))
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features, kernel_size=(self.cnn_kernel_size,))(gater_input)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.max_pool(y, window_shape=(self.pool_window,), strides=(self.pool_window,))
        y = y.reshape((y.shape[0], -1))
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.hidden_dim)(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        logits = nn.Dense(features=self.num_experts)(y)
        return nn.softmax(logits, axis=-1)

class MoE_Final_Synthesis(nn.Module):
    num_experts: int
    expert_params: dict
    gating_params: dict

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        experts = nn.vmap(
            FactorizedMlpRcExpert, in_axes=None, out_axes=1,
            variable_axes={'params': 0},
            split_rngs={'params': True},
            axis_size=self.num_experts
        )(**self.expert_params, name="experts")

        gating_network = CnnGatingNetwork(**self.gating_params, name="gating")
        gating_weights = gating_network(x)
        expert_outputs = experts(x, training=training)

        gating_weights_reshaped = jnp.expand_dims(jnp.expand_dims(gating_weights, -1), -1)
        final_output = jnp.sum(expert_outputs * gating_weights_reshaped, axis=1)
        return final_output

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        # Expert params from Episteme's SOTA
        'latent_dim': 320,
        'proj_rank': 32,
        'mlp_hidden_dim': 512,
        # My proven Gating params
        'num_experts': 4,
        'gating_hidden_dim': 32,
        'gating_cnn_features': 16,
        'gating_cnn_kernel_size': 128,
        'gating_pool_window': 256,
    }

class ModelWrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams):
        expert_params = {k: v for k, v in hparams.items() if k in ['latent_dim', 'proj_rank', 'mlp_hidden_dim']}

        # Fix: Properly map the gating parameters with correct names
        gating_params = {
            'num_experts': hparams.get('num_experts'),
            'hidden_dim': hparams.get('gating_hidden_dim'),
            'cnn_features': hparams.get('gating_cnn_features'),
            'cnn_kernel_size': hparams.get('gating_cnn_kernel_size'),
            'pool_window': hparams.get('gating_pool_window'),
        }

        self.model = MoE_Final_Synthesis(num_experts=hparams.get('num_experts'), expert_params=expert_params, gating_params=gating_params)
        self.mutable = []
        self.needs_rng = False

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        return self.model.init(rng_key, dummy_input)

    def apply(self, params, x, training=False, mutable=None, rngs=None):
        return self.model.apply(params, x)

def create_network(hparams):
    return ModelWrapper(hparams)
